entry.name: HORA
entry.title: RoboWheel: A Data Engine from Real-World Human Demonstrations for Cross-Embodiment Robotic Learning
entry.summary: Human hand-object interactions recorded with a Paxini EVT2 glove (16 tactile sensors on fingertips, finger pads and palm; 29 magnetic joint encoders) and up to 11 synchronized cameras (3 RealSense D455 RGB-D), released as 63,141 HDF5 trajectories with MANO hand fits, 6-DoF object pose, contact labels and hand and object tactile maps, inside the ~150k-trajectory HORA set built by the RoboWheel data engine.
entry.hand: Human hand in a Paxini EVT2 glove (29 magnetic joint encoders, 16 tactile sensors); one or both hands not stated

sensor.note: Paper: '16 Gen3 tactile (haptic) sensors mounted on key contact regions (fingertips, finger pads, and palm)' for local normal force. Card: tactile_hand and tactile_object are 'dense tactile map' arrays (time x sensors/vertices), Mocap subset only. Shape, rate and units not stated; files not opened.

scale.text: HORA(Mocap) 63,141 trajectories with glove touch; HORA(Recordings) 23,560 and HORA(Public Dataset) 66,924 without touch; ~150k trajectories and 918.1 GB in total. Subjects, objects, tasks and hours not stated.

entry.access: Hugging Face HORA-DB/HORA, ungated: per-episode HDF5 files under Mocap/<object id>/ with object assets under Mocap/object/, and a Recordings/ folder for the subset without touch.
caveats: Touch comes from 16 discrete Paxini sensors per glove; the released 'dense tactile map' for the hand and the object is not defined in the paper or the card, and no object-side sensor is described, so the object map is likely derived from the glove and contact fitting.
Only the Mocap subset (63,141 trajectories) carries touch; the Recordings (23,560) and Public Dataset (66,924, retargeted from public HOI corpora) subsets have none.
On 2026-10-30 the Hugging Face Mocap/ folder held 9 object folders (100017 to 101152) and their assets; whether these contain all 63,141 trajectories was not checked.
Number of participants, objects, tasks, recording hours, glove and camera rates, and whether one or both hands wear the glove are not stated in the paper or the card.
The card's robot fields (gripper states, end-effector pose, joint-space actions for 6/7-DoF arms) come from retargeting in the RoboWheel pipeline; no robot hand touch is recorded.
The data card states Apache-2.0; the arXiv paper text itself is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

tracking.note: 29 magnetic encoders over the wrist, palm and phalanges; glove signals and multi-view video are used to fit MANO parameters
6-DoF object pose released; estimation method for the Mocap subset not stated

sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2512.02729 (dataset and capture sections, first 100,000 characters)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/HORA-DB/HORA (README.md, repository metadata, commit history, tree listing of Mocap/, Mocap/100017 and Mocap/object)
unconfirmed: episodes=63,141 is the HORA(Mocap) count from the card and paper Table 1; the released files were not counted.
Mocap/100017 lists HDF5 files of 4.5-5.4 MB each (first 15 files seen); other folders not listed.
Sensing principle not stated for the Gen3 sensors; Paxini's other catalogued products use Hall-effect (magnetic) tactile arrays.
The Paxini EVT2 glove has no maker page in the catalog's sources and is not in data/hardware.json.

download.format: HDF5 per episode: Mocap/<object id>/episode_<n>_<time>_..._merged.hdf5, object assets in Mocap/object/obj_<id>/, Recordings/ for the subset without touch
